requirements.title: Character Turnaround Views
requirements.definition: Provide front, side, and back views of the character as a turnaround.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the required viewing angles only; facial expressions and poses are separately testable character-sheet outputs.

requirements.title: Multiple Character Facial Expressions
requirements.definition: Provide multiple distinct facial expressions for the character.
requirements.boundary_note: Facial-expression variants can be delivered, changed, or assessed independently of turnaround angles and body poses.

requirements.title: Multiple Character Poses
requirements.definition: Provide multiple distinct poses for the character.
requirements.boundary_note: Pose variants are independently assessable and may succeed or fail separately from facial expressions and turnaround views.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer's statement that the budget covers only the character sheet may propose a scope limitation, but no unambiguous client acceptance of that limitation is present.
The broad completion claim refers to the work generally and does not independently identify which character-sheet outputs were completed.
